families.ownerConfirmation: Roger Roman confirmed on 2026-09-04 that the two duplicate legacy C.R.S. § 24-72-711 eligibility blockers are reclassified into fail-closed execution using the committed JDF-2371 mapping.

legacyBlocksReclassified.legacyBlock: The list of qualifying offense categories under § 24-72-711 must be confirmed before the product selects an eligibility basis.
legacyBlocksReclassified.executionTreatment: The product may build only when screening and the exact conviction record establish that the convicted conduct is no longer prohibited. Missing, inconsistent, or unresolved facts hard-stop for human review; the product must not infer the election.

legacyBlocksReclassified.legacyBlock: The same eligibility issue was separately recorded as an open question blocking the build.
legacyBlocksReclassified.executionTreatment: The duplicate is superseded by the same fail-closed rule: route-determined and record-determined selections are applied only from established facts, participant assertions stay blank, and unresolved legal elections hard-stop.

laneReturnQuestionsDisposed.laneQuestion: JDF-2371: approved route-determined basis and eligibility-election selections for decriminalized conduct
laneReturnQuestionsDisposed.disposition: The committed official-form election mapping supplies the exact JDF-2371 selection rules and hard stop.

laneReturnQuestionsDisposed.laneQuestion: JDF-2374: approved field-by-field classification of judicial findings, service, and later-completion fields
laneReturnQuestionsDisposed.disposition: This is form-face field ownership, not a legal decision. JDF-2374 expressly says 'The Court Completes the Rest of this Form' immediately before sections 1 through 4. The builder may prefill only the established court, case-caption, case-number, and defendant-identity fields above that instruction; every judicial finding, notice/service finding, later-completion fact, other order, signature, judicial-role election, and order date at or below it remains protected and blank. Any field whose ownership cannot be established from the form face hard-stops the build.
